Durum wheat semolina is also a healthy choice for pasta as it is very high in protein and low in gluten. Their pasta also has a high level of Vitamin A and D due to their unusual ingredients.

description: Senatore Cappelli is a durum wheat variety, selected in 1915 by agronomist Nazareno Strampelli. This authentic Italian grain was dedicated to Marchese Raffaele Cappelli from Abruzzo, Senator of the Italian Kingdom and promoter of the 20th century Agrarian Reform. This autumnal variety is well suited for organic farming due to its considerable height, which can reach above 1.5 meters (4 feet). This 100% Italian-grown Senatore Cappelli variety has unique and distinctive brownish-black awns with large glassy grains. After milling, the resulting semolina has a bright amber-yellow color. The pasta has a subtle sweet, malty flavor and pleasing supple texture. From the Italian word spago meaning "string or thread," there is no pasta in the world more famous than Spaghetti. We strongly recommend you serve this Senatore Cappelli Spaghetti with olive oil-based sauces or simple tomato sauce so you may enjoy its flavor and texture.

description: De Cecco gently grinds the heart of each grain, mixes it with cold spring water, then kneads the dough slowly. This results in pasta with the exceptional de Cecco aroma, flavor, and consistency. Pasta easily cooks to perfection, has a great firm texture, and a delicious “fresh” pasta taste. It has a rougher surface, which helps the sauce stick to it. Since 1886 we have liked our pasta to be bronze drawn and slowly dried because we like it to fall into the plate full of taste, rough and always "al dente". Even though our taste has not changed, as we feel the same love for tradition, we have continued to improve our production technologies. Make de Cecco pasta the secret ingredient for your most amazing dishes.Buon Appetito! Penne Lisce are part of the short, diagonal cut, smooth pasta family and are one of the most well-known type of pasta, as well as being the most versatile for cooking. The lack of ridges is compensated for by a surprising softness which makes it exceptionally delicate on the palate. It is a delicate and sophisticated pasta which brings out the best in aromas, flavours and fragrance. In Italian, the term "Penne" refers to the goose feather which was used historically to write with and was cut on a diagonal to achieve a really thin tip. The shape, obtained from a pasta tube, can be smooth or ridged, of varying length and has the typical diagonal cut of a quill. Penne are one of the few types of pasta for which there is an exact date when it was created. Indeed, in 1865, a pasta-maker from San Martino d'Albaro (Genoa), Giovanni Battista Capurro, requested and obtained a patent for a diagonal cutting machine. The patent was important because it meant the fresh pasta could be cut like a quill without crushing it and in different lengths from 3 to 5 centimetres (mezze "half" penne or penne). The document preserved in the Central Archive of the State of Rome reads: "Up until now, a diagonal cut could only be made by hand with a pair of scissors which, in addition to being slow and time-consuming, also resulted in an irregular cut which flattened the pasta". The ideal condiments for Penne Lisce are any kind of meat sauce: pork, beef, sausage, slow-cooked or braised, or meat and mushrooms. This pasta is equally as good with vegetable based sauces and more in general, due to its versatility, for any recipe from the Mediterranean tradition, such as the classic condiment with tomato, basil, extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of parmesan. A classic combination is with Arrabbiata sauce. Available in 16.0 oz and 5 lb.

description:
Looking for organic pasta with sourdough culture?
A healthy & vegan high protein gluten free pasta with easy digestion?
Meet the award-winning & revolutionary Pasta FermentataTM by Kaslo Sourdough! Using an original sourdough gluten free prep method with fermentation, we’ve created pasta that anyone can eat, easily digest, and enjoy. Pasta with texture and flavor that is so good you can eat it without any sauce.

About
Our ancestors predominantly consumed grains only after they were naturally fermented with a sourdough culture. Modern ‘yeast-only-breads’ have replaced this tradition, and these gluten-containing grains are now in many non-traditional modern foods. This caused modern gastrointestinal ailments, food allergies, gluten sensitivities, colitis, Crohn’s disease, and Celiac Disease.
These are all health problems stemming from not observing how nature intended these gluten-containing cereal crop foods to be eaten. The mandatory practice of sourdough fermentation our ancestors relied on has largely fallen to the wayside.
Our mission has been to revive this ancient knowledge into this extraordinary product of ‘Pasta FermentataTM’. Sourdough pasta has all of the benefits of any naturally fermented food like sauerkraut, kombucha tea, kefir, fermented veggies.
Bacterial cultures play a crucial role in food production, by converting raw, hard to digest, gluten-containing grains into nutritious life-sustaining beneficial foods & sourdough is the classic example of functional food. It breaks apart the bonds that hold together the proteins (gluten) in these cereal grains. Lactic acid bacteria together with specific enzymes break the molecular bonds of the proteins (glutenin and gliadin), splitting them into amino acids that our digestive systems can easily assimilate. We have tailored our sourdough culture to precisely accomplish this feat.
Silvio Lettrari, Owner Kaslo Sourdough

Make de Cecco pasta the secret ingredient for your most amazing dishes.Buon Appetito! Lasagna is one of the oldest forms of pasta recorded. It probably corresponds to the Latin "Lagana" (which in turn was derived from the Greek "laganon": large, flat sheet of pasta cut into strips) and it began to be known as "Lasagna" probably after the year 1000 AD. The first traces of the widespread use of the term "Lasagna" can be found in the works of the most renowned 12th century Italian poets. "Granel di pepe vince / per virtù la lasagna", (a peppercorn beats lasagna for virtue) states Jacopone da Todi. Cecco Angiolieri,on the other hand, warns his readers, "chi de l'altrui farina fa lasagne / il su' castello non ha ne muro ne fosso" (He who makes lasagna with another's flour / his castle will have no walls or moat). It has long been one of the most well-known and popular types of pasta in Italian cooking, and the simplest and most commonly used recipe calls for a ragù, béchamel and parmesan, although mozzarella has also been introduced more recently. Delicious "white" versions are also quite commonplace with sauces made from mushrooms and vegetables. Available in 1 lb.

Konjac pasta is made with konjac flour containing the water soluble dietary fibre glucomannan. Studies have shown konjac glucomannan in your diet is beneficial to our health in many ways:

Weight management – Glucomannan fills the stomach and slows the digestion process, which helps the consumer feel “full” for longer, reducing the urge for heavy meals or snacks.

Help control blood sugar levels – By extending the time required to digest a meal, sugars and carbohydrates from other food intake are processed slower, which reduces spikes in blood sugar levels.

Reduce cholesterol – Glucomannan gel in the digestive system inhibits the absorption of lipids, such as LDL (bad cholesterol).

Keep in cool and dry place, avoid direct sunlight, refrigerated once opened and use within 3 days; do not freeze

1. Open the package and drain liquid away;

Please note the pasta is very absorbent so will absorb the sauces and take on the flavours you cook them with.

description: Our Pasta is Something Else. The secret lies in the wheat germ! The products of the ancient Morelli pasta production factory are unique, the secret being an ingredient that is not found in most common types of pasta, which is wheat germ, the heart of the grain itself and which contains vitamins, as well as vegetable protein. During the normal cereal grinding process,the wheat germ is removed from the semolina in order to reduce the perishableness of the product, which means that the pasta factories are forced to process the flour without the wheat germ. But thanks to the craft workmanship methods used by the Morelli pasta factory the wheat germ , that is always fresh, is re-incorporated into the semolina; and this has given rise to our slogan “OUR PASTA IS SOMETHING ELSE”. Through years of using the wheat germ ingredient the ancient Morelli pasta factory has succeeded in obtaining a pasta with a unique and delicious taste, which releases a wonderful aroma on cooking, the cooking water, taking on a slight green hue, as the result of the presence of the fresh wheat germ ingredient. Pasta Morelli is considered to be of the finest quality, not only because of its wheat germ ingredient, but also because it selects the best durum wheat semolina, which is processed according to craft technique. The machines slowly press the kneaded mixture and, after having hand rolled it on frames, the pasta is dried in storage rooms for 36 hours at no more than 45°/50°C. Thereby maintaining the intrinsic taste and nutritious properties of the product. The ancient Morelli Pasta factory was founded in 1860, is a family-run enterprise, the fifth generation of the Morelli family, siblings Lucia, Antonio and Marco, continue to run the company today preserving its traditions. It produces a vast range of specialities, using ancient craft techniques, free of both preservatives and colouring agents. The result is truly wholesome pasta, with a wonderfully rich flavour and full consistency.

description: De Cecco gently grinds the heart of each grain, mixes it with cold spring water, then kneads the dough slowly. This results in pasta with the exceptional de Cecco aroma, flavor, and consistency. Pasta easily cooks to perfection, has a great firm texture, and a delicious “fresh” pasta taste. It has a rougher surface, which helps the sauce stick to it. Since 1886 we have liked our pasta to be bronze drawn and slowly dried because we like it to fall into the plate full of taste, rough and always "al dente". Even though our taste has not changed, as we feel the same love for tradition, we have continued to improve our production technologies. Make de Cecco pasta the secret ingredient for your most amazing dishes.Buon Appetito! Tortiglioni are one of many varieties of maccherone, one of the oldest types of pasta originating from Naples. The name in Italian refers to the shape and comes from the Vulgar Latin tortillare which literally means to wrap in a spiral with a characteristic pattern from the lathe used in pasta production. The shape is particularly versatile, but also very original, and best suited to full-bodied sauces. Tortiglioni are excellent served with succulent, meat-based sauces. They are also very good served with tomato sauce or vegetable and tomato sauces. It is a particularly suitable type of pasta for oven-baked dishes. Available in 16.0 oz and 5 lb pack.

description:
Gourmet Pasta

All the flavor of homemade pasta with wheat germ sets this heart-shaped heirloom pasta apart from all others. Wheat germ is the heart of the grain of wheat, rich in flavor and nourishing active ingredients. The wheat germ contains vitamins A, D, and E and also provides a wonderful aroma while cooking. The wheat germ also gives the cooking water a slightly green hue making cooking Morelli’s fresh pasta a completely unique experience. The durum wheat semolina is a little thicker and is able to absorb sauces well and give more succulent and full-bodied wheat flavor to your meals. Our flavored pasta colors are created using only natural ingredients - red beet creates the beautiful red hue in our heart-shaped pasta.

Versatile and Healthy

Our pasta can be used in classic Italian dishes and is especially good served al dente with just a touch of olive oil. The pasta holds up beautifully in more complex meals with vegetables, meats, or seafood added to it as well. Durum wheat semolina is also a healthy choice for pasta as it is very high in protein and low in gluten. It's easy to cook to a perfect al dente in 9-10 minutes. Perfect for celebrating birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's day, or just saying I love you.

Imported From Italy

Morelli has been creating gourmet Italian pasta in Tuscany since 1860 and is a family-run company with the 5th generation currently preserving the traditions their ancestors put into place. They utilize an artisanal method of reincorporating wheat germ into semolina to create their pasta with a unique taste and the aroma of wheat. Their pasta also has a high level of Vitamin A and D due to their unusual ingredients.

Morelli offers classic and traditional types of pasta. They also have pasta that features aromas such as saffron, Boletus mushrooms, and sepia in order to offer a full and comprehensive range of pasta products. Morelli’s pasta is something else!

description: Granoro’s Gluten Free pasta has chosen a mix of corn flour, rice flour and quinoa flour. This well-balanced mixture produces a product that is very similar to conventional pasta in terms of color, flavor and consistency, offering a gluten-free option that is just as delicious and flavorsome as durum wheat pasta. Corn is an ancient cereal that first appeared in Europe after the discovery of America and is now one of the most commonly grown crops. Rich in iron, phosphorous and potassium; it contains Vitamin A and is gluten free. Rice is the most highly consumed gluten-free product in the world, but also one of the most commonly grown crops. Quinoa is classed as a pseudocereal. It originates from Peru; it is GMO-free and usually organic. Quinoa is more expensive than rice or corn because it is difficult to grow and comes from far away countries. Quinoa is recommended for celiacs as it is completely gluten free and is a valid alternative to animal protein thanks to its high protein content. Granoro Gluten Free pasta has a smell and taste typical of corn, slightly softened by the rice flour and vegetable notes from the quinoa. Quinoa has been added to balance the intake of fibre, mineral salts and protein, which are lacking in rice and corn. The three types of flour used give the pasta a yellow color very similar to that of durum wheat pasta instead of the glassy yellow color often attributed to other makes. The pasta also remains firm after cooking and has a rough surface that binds well with sauces.

description: Hoo-Mee Gravy Mix 1 Pound Ingredients: Cornstarch, Sugar, Salt, Monosodium Glutamate, Caramel, Granulated Onion, Ground Celery Seed, Pure and Artificial Spices. Combine this Hoo-Mee Gravy Mix with the complementary chow mein noodles for the dish made famous by the Fall River, MA area Chinese restaurants. The Oriental Chow Mein Company’s signature gravy mix has become a staple for area establishments since it’s inception in 1926. When it comes to Chinese cuisine in this region, the Hoo-Mee brand is the only choice for chow mein. Hoo-Mee Gravy Mix is the ingredient that makes area Chinese restaurants unique in their flavor and consistency. With this 1 lb. package of gravy mix you can prepare your own chow mein dishes at home. Add 1 cup of chopped onion, and 1 cup of chopped celery to 3 cups boiling water or soup stock. A few bean sprouts may also be added. Cook until vegetables are tender. Dissolve 1 ounce gravy mix (1 heaping tablespoon) in 1/2 cup warm water, and add to the mixture. Pour over Hoo-Mee Chow Mein Noodles and serve immediately. Depending on your preference, chopped pork, beef, shrimp, scallops, or chicken may also be added to the gravy mix or served on top. Traditionally, chow mein can be served in two ways, strained or unstrained. Strained, the gravy is cooked with vegetables of your choosing, but the vegetables are removed or “strained” prior to serving over chow mein noodles. In the unstrained version the gravy is cooked the same way but the vegetables are left in and served over the noodles. Either option provides optimal flavor, the only difference being individual preferences.

title: Dal Raccolto Bronze Die Cut Pasta, Spaghetti, 1 lb (Pack of 3)
bullet_point: [Italian artisanal bronze die cut pasta - 100% durum wheat, TWO SIMPLE INGREDIENTS: Durum Wheat Semolina and Water, Cooks in 9-11 minutes, Product of Italy, AIR DRIED from 24 to 72 Hours]
description:
Dal Raccolto Italian Artisanal Bronze Die Pasta is produced in accordance with time-honored traditions. The process begins by selecting the finest locally milled durum wheat semolina and kneading it together with purified mountain water to create truly homemade quality "dough". The dough is then extruded slowly through bronze-dies by the craftsmen and then skillfully dried on looms or within wooden trays for up to 20 hours, which completes the age-old process. The resulting artisan pasta is then packaged and represents Italy's very best quality in compliance with treasured traditions.

Dal Raccolto Italian Artisanal Bronze Die Pasta מיוצרת בהתאם למסורות מכובדות. התהליך מתחיל על ידי בחירת סולת חיטה דורום המקומית הטובה ביותר ולוש אותה יחד עם מי הרים מטוהרים כדי ליצור "בצק" באיכות תוצרת בית. הבצק מוציא לאט דרך מברונזה על ידי בעלי המלאכה ואז מיובש במיומנות על נולים או בתוך מגשי עץ עד 20 שעות, אשר משלים את התהליך הישן. פסטה אומנותית וכתוצאה מכך נארזת ומייצגת את האיכות הטובה ביותר באיטליה תוך ציות למסורות יקרות

Dal Raccolto italienische Bronze-Stanzform wird nach altehrwürdigen Traditionen hergestellt. Der Prozess beginnt, indem Sie den feinsten lokal gemahlenen Durumweizengrieß auswählen und ihn mit gereinigtem Bergwasser kneten, um wirklich hausgemachten Qualitätsteig herzustellen. Der Teig wird dann von den Handwerkern langsam durch Bronzeformen extrudiert und anschließend gekonnt auf Webstühlen oder in Holzschalen für bis zu 20 Stunden getrocknet, was den uralten Prozess vervollständigt. Die daraus resultierende Pasta wird dann verpackt und stellt die beste Qualität Italiens unter Einhaltung wertvoller Traditionen dar.

يتم إنتاج معكرونة داي البرونزي الإيطالي المصنوع بحرفية من Dal Raccolto وفقًا للتقاليد المعترف بها بمرور الوقت. تبدأ العملية باختيار أفضل سيمولينا القمح المطحون محليًا وعجنه مع مياه جبلية نقية لخلق "عجين" عالية الجودة في المنزل. ثم يتم استخراج العجين ببطء من خلال قوالب البرونز من قبل الحرفيين ثم يتم تجفيفه بمهارة على نول أو داخل الصواني الخشبية لمدة تصل إلى 20 ساعة، مما يكمل العملية القديمة. ثم يتم تعبئة المعكرونة المصنوعة بحرفية وتمثل أفضل جودة في إيطاليا بما يتوافق مع التقاليد الثمينة.

A massa italiana de bronze artesanal da Dal Raccolto é produzida de acordo com as tradições honradas. O processo começa selecionando a melhor sêmolina de trigo duro moída localmente e amassando-a junto com água purificada da montanha para criar uma verdadeira "massa" de qualidade caseira. A massa é então extrudada lentamente através de moldes de bronze pelos artesãos e então seca habilmente em teares ou dentro de bandejas de madeira por até 20 horas, o que completa o processo antigo. A massa artesanal resultante é embalada e representa a melhor qualidade da Itália em conformidade com as tradições preciosas.

Dal Raccolto 意大利手工青铜意大利面是根据历史悠久的传统生产的。 这一过程首先是选择当地研磨的硬粒小麦粗面粉,并用纯净的山水揉搓,打造真正的自制质量"面团"。 然后由工匠通过青铜模具慢慢挤出面团,然后在织机或木托盘内巧妙地干燥面团长达20小时,以完成陈旧的过程。 然后将制作出的工匠面食包装,代表意大利的优良品质,符合珍贵传统。

description: Versatile PastaPennoni is Italian for “large quills” and their shape resembles the end of a quill pen. The pasta has a rustic texture that is porous and because of this, it is the perfect pasta to combine with every type of sauce. Our Pennoni pasta is a larger version of penne and has large tubes that can hold onto hearty meat sauces and can even be stuffed before baking. Pennoni is versatile and can be used in simple dishes with light seasoning as well as being paired with meats, cheeses, or vegetables.Imported From ItalyNo one knows pasta like the Italians, and the Panarese family is a superb example of this. Pasta Panarese creates authentic Italian pasta exclusively from wheat grown in Panarese's own fields in the beautiful Val d'Orcia (Orcia Valley) in the province of Siena. Val d'Orcia is a wonderful Tuscan valley that is a Natural Park, as well as a UNESCO World Heritage site. Since ancient times it has been renowned for its high-quality durum wheat.The nature of the soil and the relative summer dryness give durum wheat a high index of high-quality proteins and gluten. Panarese's gourmet Italian pasta is also made with water that flows from Monte Amiata (Mount Amiata), an exceptionally pure water source with almost no calcium residue. Ancient ProcessesThis combination of certified and exceptional Italian ingredients is then formed into a variety of pasta shapes that are all drawn through a traditional bronze die. Each batch of pasta is then air-dried at a low temperature for a minimum of 72 hours. This is an extremely time-consuming process, but it ensures that the dried pasta does not crystallize as all industrial-made pasta does. As the ancient process makes the surface of the pasta rustic and very rough, it will hold onto whatever you choose to pair it with. The process also helps to preserve the taste, smell, and look of the pasta for a unique sensory experience with your next meal.

Founded in 1918, Benedetto Cavalieri continues the family tradition of making pasta according to the time-honored "Delicate Method". Using only the highest quality, freshly milled organic durum wheat (Semolina), the process involves long kneading by experienced hands. Every shape of pasta requires a unique blend of semolina flour and water. After kneading, the dough slowly passes through special bronze dies, designed to create each shape, and give the pasta a rough textured surface, to which the sauce clings to, as opposed to falls from. After shaping, the pasta is allowed to dry in antique ovens, and rest at low temperatures. Slow drying at low temperatures retains more of the nutty flavor, and aroma of the whole grain durum wheat. Pure, delicious, and versatile, Benedetto Cavalieri Organic Whole Wheat pasta is one pantry essential you will not want to be without - buonissimo. description: Our Pasta is Something Else. The secret lies in the wheat germ! The products of the ancient Morelli pasta production factory are unique, the secret being an ingredient that is not found in most common types of pasta, which is wheat germ, the heart of the grain itself and which contains vitamins, as well as vegetable protein. During the normal cereal grinding process,the wheat germ is removed from the semolina in order to reduce the perishableness of the product, which means that the pasta factories are forced to process the flour without the wheat germ. But thanks to the craft workmanship methods used by the Morelli pasta factory the wheat germ , that is always fresh, is re-incorporated into the semolina; and this has given rise to our slogan “OUR PASTA IS SOMETHING ELSE”. Through years of using the wheat germ ingredient the ancient Morelli pasta factory has succeeded in obtaining a pasta with a unique and delicious taste, which releases a wonderful aroma on cooking, the cooking water, taking on a slight green hue, as the result of the presence of the fresh wheat germ ingredient. Pasta Morelli is considered to be of the finest quality, not only because of its wheat germ ingredient, but also because it selects the best durum wheat semolina, which is processed according to craft technique. The machines slowly press the kneaded mixture and, after having hand rolled it on frames, the pasta is dried in storage rooms for 36 hours at no more than 45°/50°C. Thereby maintaining the intrinsic taste and nutritious properties of the product. The ancient Morelli Pasta factory was founded in 1860, is a family-run enterprise, the fifth generation of the Morelli family, siblings Lucia, Antonio and Marco, continue to run the company today preserving its traditions. It produces a vast range of specialities, using ancient craft techniques, free of both preservatives and colouring agents. The result is truly wholesome pasta, with a wonderfully rich flavour and full consistency.

This autumnal variety is well suited for organic farming due to its considerable height, which can reach above 1.5 meters (4 feet). Traditionally served alla Pugliese (with broccoli rabe, sausage, and garlic) or with a hearty meat ragù so that the sauce is cupped in the pasta.

description: Benedetto Cavalieri is one of the leading family owned companies that produce pasta by old-World artisanal methods. Founded in 1918, Benedetto Cavalieri continues the family tradition of making pasta according to the time-honored "Delicate Method". Using only the highest quality, freshly milled durum wheat (Semolina), the process involves long kneading by experienced hands. Every shape of pasta requires a unique blend of semolina flour and water. After kneading, the dough slowly passes through special bronze dies, designed to create each shape, and give the pasta a rough textured surface, to which the sauce clings to, as opposed to falls from. After shaping, the pasta is allowed to dry in antique ovens, and rest at low temperatures. Slow drying at low temperatures retains more of the nutty flavor, and aroma of the durum wheat. Pure, delicious, and versatile, Benedetto Cavalieri pasta is one pantry essential you will not want to be without - buonissimo!! Benedetto Cavalieri Pastas have won 2 SOFI Awards from the NASFT

description: Faella Spaghettini have a lighter mouthfeel than spaghetti, and are perfect for any dishes that call for thin spaghetti or angel hair. Use them in a simple dressing of sauteed garlic and olive oil, or add colatura, parsley and a pinch of chili pepper for a richly savory southern Italian delicacy. Pasta Faella is crafted according to tradition in the legendary birthplace of Italian dried pasta, Gragnano. This pasta is real Italian pasta at its best. When cooked, this pasta fills the room with the intense aroma of freshly baked bread and toasted grain. Its slightly rough, porous texture creates an ideal surface for collecting sauces, and its consistency is firm and chewy - just be sure to cook it al dente to fully savor its flavor and texture! Pasta Faella is made from nothing but the highest quality durum wheat and pristine spring waters from the Lattari mountains. The pasta is extruded through traditional bronze dies created specifically for each shape, and is air dried naturally for at least two days - unlike industrial pasta that is dried in less than an hour at high temperatures in electric ovens. According to Sergio Faella, in industrial pasta production, during high-temperature drying the pasta undergoes a kind of plastification, which causes it to absorb less water; in contrast, artisanal pasta expands visibly in water, is more easily digested, and gives a greater sense of satiety. Faella has been producing artisanal pasta since 1907, when Gaetano Faella founded the family company in Gragnano, a town south of Naples in the region of Campania. Gragnano is considered the birthplace of Italian dried pasta; according to legend, the breezes that flow from the mountains to the sea created the perfect conditions for drying pasta, and until the last century, all Gragnano families made and dried pasta in the streets.

description:
Indomie Mi Goreng is an instant noodles product line made under the Indomie brand by the Indofood company, the world's largest instant noodle manufacturer, located in Indonesia. Mi Goreng is Indonesian for "fried noodle". Indomie Mi Goreng is simply abbreviated as Indomie goreng by most Indonesians. Indomie Goreng is a type of instant noodle served without soup and is stirred well with soysauce, oil, and seasoning. This instant noodle derived its inspiration from traditional Indonesian dish called mi goreng, a variant of fried noodle common in Indonesia. Many street vendors sell it and traditional mi goreng is considered as common food by the people. This product has gained a cult following in Indonesia and in various other countries, such as Nigeria and Australia.

Indomie Mi Goreng es una línea de productos de fideos instantáneos hecha bajo la marca Indomie por la empresa Indofood, el mayor fabricante de fideos instantáneos del mundo, ubicado en Indonesia. Mi Goreng es indonesio para "fideos fritos". Indomie Mi Goreng es simplemente abreviado como Indomie goreng por la mayoría de los indonesios. Indomie Goreng es un tipo de fideos instantáneos servidos sin sopa y se agita bien con soysauce, aceite y condimento. Este fideo instantáneo derivó su inspiración del plato tradicional indonesio llamado mi goreng, una variante de fideos fritos común en Indonesia. Muchos vendedores ambulantes lo venden y mi goreng tradicional es considerado como comida común por la gente. Este producto ha ganado un culto en Indonesia y en varios otros países, como Nigeria y Australia.

Indomie Mi Goreng ist eine Instant-Nudel-Produktlinie, die unter der Marke Indomie von der Firma Indofood hergestellt wird, dem weltweit größten Instant-Nudelhersteller, mit Sitz in Indonesien. Mi Goreng ist Indonesier für "Bratnudel". Indomie Mi Goreng wird von den meisten Indonesier einfach als Indomie Goreng abgekürzt. Indomie Goreng ist eine Art Instant-Nudeln, die ohne Suppe serviert wird und gut mit Sojasauce, Öl und Gewürzen gerührt wird. Diese Instant-Nudel hat ihre Inspiration aus dem traditionellen indonesischen Gericht namens Mi Goreng, eine Variante von gebratenen Nudeln, die in Indonesien häufig verbreitet ist. Viele Straßenhändler verkaufen es und traditionelles Mi Goreng wird von den Menschen als gewöhnliches Essen angesehen. Dieses Produkt hat sich in Indonesien und in verschiedenen anderen Ländern wie Nigeria und Australien einen Kultanspruch gewonnen.

Indomie Mi Goreng הוא קו מוצרי אטריות מיידי שנעשה תחת המותג Indomie על ידי חברת אינדופוד, יצרן האטריות המיידי הגדול בעולם, הממוקם באינדונזיה. Mi Goreng הוא אינדונזית עבור "אטריות מטוגנות". Indomie Mi Goreng פשוט מקוצר כIndomie goreng על ידי רוב האינדונזים. Indomie Goreng הוא סוג של אטריות מיידיות מוגשות ללא מרק ועורבות היטב עם רוטב סויה, שמן ותבלינים. אטריות מיידיות זו נגזרות השראה ממאכל אינדונזית מסורתי הנקרא mi going_, גרסה של אטריות מטוגנות נפוצות באינדונזיה. ספקי רחוב רבים מוכרים את זה ואת mi goreng המסורתי נחשב למזון נפוץ על ידי אנשים. מוצר זה קיבל פולחן בעקבות אינדונזיה ובמדינות שונות אחרות, כגון ניגריה ואוסטרליה.

Indomie Mi Goreng é uma linha de produtos de macarrão instantâneo feita sob a marca Indomie pela empresa Indofood, a maior fabricante de macarrão instantâneo do mundo, localizada na Indonésia. Mi Goreng é indonésio para "macarrão frito". Indomie Mi Goreng é simplesmente abreviada como Indomie Goreng pela maioria dos indonésios. Indomie Goreng é um tipo de macarrão instantâneo servido sem sopa e é misturado bem com soyauce, óleo e tempero. Este macarrão instantâneo deriva sua inspiração do tradicional prato indonésio chamado mi goreng, uma variante de macarrão frito comum na Indonésia. Muitos vendedores de rua vendem e o tradicional mi goreng é considerado como comida comum pelas pessoas. Este produto ganhou um culto seguidores na Indonésia e em vários outros países, como a Nigéria e Austrália.

Indomie Mi Goreng 是印度尼西亚最大的速食面生产商 Indofood 公司在Indomie 品牌下制造的即时面条产品系列。 Mi Goreng 是印尼语的"炒面"。 Indomie Mi Goreng 被大多数印度尼西亚人简称为 Indomie goreng。 Indomie Goreng 是一种无需汤的即食面条,与酱油、油和调味料混合。 这款即食面条的灵感源自印度尼西亚传统菜肴,名为 mi goreng,这是印度尼西亚常见的油炸面条款式。 许多街头供应商出售它,传统 mi goreng 被认为是普通食物。 在印度尼西亚和尼日利亚和澳大利亚等国家也备受追捧。

Indomie Mi Goreng 是 Indomie 品牌下製造的速麵產品線,由位於印尼的世界最大的速麵製造商Indofood 公司。 Mi Goreng 是印尼的「炒麵」。 Indomie Mi Goreng 被大多數印尼人簡單地縮寫為 Indomie Goreng。 Indomie Goreng 是一種無湯的即食麵,可攪拌醬油、油和調味料。 這款方便麵的靈感源於傳統印尼菜,稱為 mi goreng,印度尼西亞常見的煎麵。 許多街頭小販都出售,傳統的 mi goreng 被人們視為普通食物。 本產品在印尼和其他國家,如奈及利亞和澳洲,已贏得喜愛。

Indomie Mi Goreng은 인도네시아에 위치한 세계 최대의 인스턴트 누들 제조업체인 Indofood 회사에 의해 인도미 브랜드로 만든 인스턴트 누들 제품 라인입니다. Mi Goreng은 인도네시아어로 "튀김 국수"입니다. Indomie Mi Goreng은 대부분의 인도네시아인들에 의해 간단히 약칭됩니다. Indomie Goreng은 수프 없이 제공되는 인스턴트 국수 유형이며 간장, 오일 및 시즈닝과 잘 저어줍니다. 이 인스턴트 국수는 인도네시아에서 흔히 튀긴 국수의 변형인 mi goreng이라고 불리는 전통 인도네시아 요리에서 영감을 얻었습니다. 많은 노점상들이 이를 판매하며 전통적인 미고렝은 사람들이 일반적인 음식으로 간주합니다. 이 제품은 인도네시아 및 나이지리아와 호주와 같은 다양한 나라에서 컬트를 얻고 있습니다.

description:
In 2006, Jonathan Carp, MD was visiting a friend in Japan when she took him to a Buddhist-run vegetarian restaurant on the outskirts of the beautiful city of Kyoto. He was introduced to konnyaku in different shapes and in noodles called shirataki. After discovering the health benefits of this amazing plant-based food and the positive health implications for his patients, he started Miracle Noodle with his family. As Miracle Noodle received positive accolades from the likes of Dr. Oz, Rachael Ray, Rocco Dispirito and being featured in magazines like Cosmo, Men Health, and First for Women and TV shows like The View, ABC News, Hollywood Tonight - the company expanded and so did the product offerings. We now offer a line of products consistent with the health goals of our customers, making healthy eating easy and delicious. All of our products are non-gmo, vegan, and grain free with an ever expanding option of organic options as well.

في عام 2006، كانت شركة جوناثان كارب، شركة إم دي تزور صديقًا في اليابان عندما أخذته إلى مطعم نباتي يديره البوذية على ضواحي مدينة كيوتو. تم تقديمه إلى كونياكو بأشكال مختلفة وبنودلز تسمى شيراتاكي. بعد اكتشاف الفوائد الصحية لهذا الطعام النباتي المذهل والآثار الصحية الإيجابية للمرضاه، بدأ ميراكل نودل مع عائلته. بينما حصلت ميراكل نودل على إقبال إيجابي من مثل دكتور أوز، راشيل راي، روكو ديسبيريتو وتم عرضه في مجلات مثل كوزمو، مين هيلث، فيرست للنساء والعروض التلفزيونية مثل ذا فيو، إيه بي سي نيوز هوليوود تونايت - الشركة توسعت وتقدمها المنتج. نقدم الآن مجموعة من المنتجات بما يتوافق مع الأهداف الصحية لعملائنا، مما يجعل تناول الطعام الصحي سهلاً ولذيذًا. جميع منتجاتنا غير معدلة وراثياً ونباتي وخالية من الحبوب مع خيار متسع باستمرار من الخيارات العضوية كذلك.

description: Yes! This pasta shape is very long. In fact they are the mother of all pasta shapes and meant to be broken to your desired length. Faella Candele are long, thick tubes of pasta that flatten when cooked for a pleasantly chewy bite. Candele are ideal with meat and tomato based sauces, but are delicious with any of your favorite combinations of cheese, meat, fish or vegetables. Or use them in a baked pasta dish, like the traditional timballi or pasticci. Pasta Faella is crafted according to tradition in the legendary birthplace of Italian dried pasta, Gragnano. This pasta is real Italian pasta at its best. When cooked, this pasta fills the room with the intense aroma of freshly baked bread and toasted grain. Its slightly rough, porous texture creates an ideal surface for collecting sauces, and its consistency is firm and chewy - just be sure to cook it al dente to fully savor its flavor and texture! Pasta Faella is made from nothing but the highest quality durum wheat and pristine spring waters from the Lattari mountains. The pasta is extruded through traditional bronze dies created specifically for each shape, and is air dried naturally for at least two days - unlike industrial pasta that is dried in less than an hour at high temperatures in electric ovens. According to Sergio Faella, in industrial pasta production, during high-temperature drying the pasta undergoes a kind of plastification, which causes it to absorb less water; in contrast, artisanal pasta expands visibly in water, is more easily digested, and gives a greater sense of satiety. Faella has been producing artisanal pasta since 1907, when Gaetano Faella founded the family company in Gragnano, a town south of Naples in the region of Campania. Gragnano is considered the birthplace of Italian dried pasta; according to legend, the breezes that flow from the mountains to the sea created the perfect conditions for drying pasta.

Linguine are the most well-known type of long pasta from Liguria: they resemble a small, flat, narrow tagliatella-type pasta and were created to be eaten with traditional pesto. It is precisely the flattened section and slightly convex shape of this pasta that makes it perfect for trapping the sauce and bringing out all the different flavours. De Cecco mahlt sanft das Herz jedes Getreide, mischt es mit kaltem Quellwasser, dann knetet den Teig langsam. Dadurch ergibt sich Nudeln mit dem außergewöhnlichen Cecco-Aroma, Geschmack und Konsistenz. يقوم دي سيسكو بطحن قلب كل حبة بلطف، ويخلطها بماء الينابيع البارد، ثم يعجن العجين ببطء. يؤدي ذلك إلى المعكرونة برائحة دي سيسكو الاستثنائية والنكهة والقوام. تطبخ المعكرونة بسهولة بشكل مثالي، ولها ملمس قوي رائع، ومذاق المعكرونة "الطازج" اللذيذ. تتميز بسطح خشن يساعد على التصاق الصلصة بها. منذ عام 1886، أحببنا أن تكون المعكرونة الخاصة بنا مصورة بالبرونز وتجفيفها ببطء لأننا نحب أن تقع في طبق مليء بالطعم والخشنة ودائمًا "ALDT". على الرغم من أن ذوقنا لم يتغير، إلا أننا نشعر بنفس حب التقليد، فقد استمرنا في تحسين تقنيات الإنتاج لدينا. اجعل معكرونة دي سيسكو المكون السري لأطباقك الأكثر روعة. بون أبتيتو! لعبة لينغويني بيكول (لينغوين صغيرة) هي مجموعة متنوعة لذيذة من لانجيوين الكلاسيكية. لينجويني هي النوع الأكثر شهرة من المعكرونة الطويلة من ليغوريا: فهي تشبه المعكرونة الصغيرة والمسطحة والضيقة من نوع تاجليتيلا وتم صنعها لتأكلها مع البيستو التقليدي. إنها قسم مسطح بدقة وشكل محدب قليلاً لهذه المعكرونة مما يجعلها مثالية لحبس الصلصة وإبراز جميع النكهات المختلفة. إنه ممتاز فقط مع الزبدة والمريمية أو ممزوج بصلصات الطماطم الطازجة، مع الخضروات والأعشاب العطرية أو الصلصات السريعة الحارة المعدة بزيت الزيتون البكر والثوم والفلفل الأحمر والأنكوفي. كما أنه مثالي مع الصلصات المصنوعة من المحار والمأكولات البحرية ومع الصلصات "البيضاء" المعدة بالكريم أو الماسكاربون أو الجبن الناعم أو الذائب مع إضافة التوابل مثل الزعفران والخيل والكاري والزنجبيل. متوفر بوزن 473 جم و2.2 كجم.

De Cecco moe suavemente o coração de cada grão, mistura-o com água fria e depois amassa a massa lentamente. Isso resulta em macarrão com o aroma excepcional de Cecco, sabor e consistência. A massa cozinha facilmente com perfeição, tem uma ótima textura firme e um delicioso sabor de macarrão "fresco". Tem uma superfície mais áspera, o que ajuda o molho a grudar. Desde 1886, gostamos que nossas massas fossem desenhadas em bronze e secas lentamente porque gostamos que caiam no prato cheio de sabor, áspero e sempre "al dente". Embora nosso gosto não tenha mudado, pois sentimos o mesmo amor pela tradição, continuamos a melhorar nossas tecnologias de produção. Faça do macarrão Cecco o ingrediente secreto para seus pratos mais incríveis. A Piccole Linguine Linguine Linguine Linguine é uma saborosa variedade da Linguine clássica. Linggenuine é o tipo mais conhecido de macarrão longo da Liguria: eles se assemelham a uma macarrão pequena, plana e estreita e foram criados para serem comidos com pesto tradicional. É precisamente a seção plana e a forma ligeiramente convexa desta massa, o que a torna perfeita para prender o molho e realçar todos os diferentes sabores. É excelente apenas com manteiga e sálvia ou combinado com molhos frescos à base de tomate, com legumes e ervas aromáticas ou molhos rápidos e picantes preparados com azeite de oliva extravirgem, alho, pimenta vermelha e anchovas. Também é ideal com molhos feitos com molhos moluscos e frutos do mar e com molhos "brancos" preparados com creme, mascarpone, queijos macios ou derretidos com a adição de especiarias como açafrão, rabanete, curry e gengibre. About Montebello Established 1388

When it comes to great pasta, we go straight to the source: the skilled Italian artisans of Montebello. Using old-world techniques, they combine organic semolina flour with a sprinkling of pure water from a neighboring spring. Bite for bite, it’s as delicious as homemade, delivering Italian excellence to any dish.

description: De Cecco gently grinds the heart of each grain, mixes it with cold spring water, then kneads the dough slowly. This results in pasta with the exceptional de Cecco aroma, flavor, and consistency. Pasta easily cooks to perfection, has a great firm texture, and a delicious “fresh” pasta taste. It has a rougher surface, which helps the sauce stick to it. Since 1886 we have liked our pasta to be bronze drawn and slowly dried because we like it to fall into the plate full of taste, rough and always "al dente". Even though our taste has not changed, as we feel the same love for tradition, we have continued to improve our production technologies. Make de Cecco pasta the secret ingredient for your most amazing dishes.Buon Appetito! Penne Rigate are part of the short, diagonal cut, ridged pasta family and are one of the most well-known type of pasta, as well as being the most versatile in the kitchen. In Italian, the term "Penne" refers to the goose feather which was used historically to write with and was cut on a diagonal to achieve a really thin tip. The shape, obtained from a pasta tube, can be smooth or ridged, of varying length and has the typical diagonal cut of a quill. Penne are one of the few types of pasta for which there is an exact date when it was created. Indeed, in 1865, a pasta-maker from San Martino d'Albaro (Genoa), Giovanni Battista Capurro, requested and obtained a patent for a diagonal cutting machine. The patent was important because it meant the fresh pasta could be cut like a quill without crushing it and in different lengths from 3 to 5 centimetres (mezze "half" penne or penne). The document preserved in the Central Archive of the State of Rome reads: "Up until now, a diagonal cut could only be made by hand with a pair of scissors which, in addition to being slow and time-consuming, also resulted in an irregular cut which flattened the pasta". Penne Rigate are perfect for preparing oven-baked pasta or pasta dishes served with meat sauces made from pork or beef. This pasta is equally as good with vegetable based sauces and more in general, due to its versatility, for any recipe from the Mediterranean tradition, such as the classic condiment with tomato, basil, extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of parmesan. A classic combination is with Arrabbiata sauce. Available in 16.0 oz and 5 lb.

description: Faella Calamari are shaped like - well, like calamari - and when cooked al dente have a similar bouncy texture. They’re the perfect pasta to pair with seafood, or with bold rustic ingredients like sundried tomatoes, artichokes, pine nuts and capers. Pasta Faella is crafted according to tradition in the legendary birthplace of Italian dried pasta, Gragnano. This pasta is real Italian pasta at its best. When cooked, this pasta fills the room with the intense aroma of freshly baked bread and toasted grain. Its slightly rough, porous texture creates an ideal surface for collecting sauces, and its consistency is firm and chewy - just be sure to cook it al dente to fully savor its flavor and texture! Pasta Faella is made from nothing but the highest quality durum wheat and pristine spring waters from the Lattari mountains. The pasta is extruded through traditional bronze dies created specifically for each shape, and is air dried naturally for at least two days - unlike industrial pasta that is dried in less than an hour at high temperatures in electric ovens. According to Sergio Faella, in industrial pasta production, during high-temperature drying the pasta undergoes a kind of plastification, which causes it to absorb less water; in contrast, artisanal pasta expands visibly in water, is more easily digested, and gives a greater sense of satiety. Faella has been producing pasta since 1907, when Gaetano Faella founded the family company in Gragnano, a town south of Naples in the region of Campania. Gragnano is considered the birthplace of Italian dried pasta; according to legend, the breezes that flow from the mountains to the sea created the perfect conditions for drying pasta, and until the last century, all Gragnano families made and dried pasta in the streets. Today, the rich, nutty aroma of pasta still wafts through the streets, but only 12 producers have been given IGP (Indicazione Geografica Protetta) status for continuing to craft pasta according to tradition.

All the flavor of homemade pasta with wheat germ sets this fusilloni heirloom pasta apart from all others. description: Faella Tofe are ridged, rounded shells - like small rounded penne - ideal with melted cheese and creamy sauces, or rustic sauteed vegetables. Pasta Faella is crafted according to tradition in the legendary birthplace of Italian dried pasta, Gragnano. This pasta is real Italian pasta at its best. When cooked, this pasta fills the room with the intense aroma of freshly baked bread and toasted grain. Its slightly rough, porous texture creates an ideal surface for collecting sauces, and its consistency is firm and chewy - just be sure to cook it al dente to fully savor its flavor and texture! Pasta Faella is made from nothing but the highest quality durum wheat and pristine spring waters from the Lattari mountains. The pasta is extruded through traditional bronze dies created specifically for each shape, and is air dried naturally for at least two days - unlike industrial pasta that is dried in less than an hour at high temperatures in electric ovens. According to Sergio Faella, in industrial pasta production, during high-temperature drying the pasta undergoes a kind of plastification, which causes it to absorb less water; in contrast, artisanal pasta expands visibly in water, is more easily digested, and gives a greater sense of satiety. Faella has been producing artisanal pasta since 1907, when Gaetano Faella founded the family company in Gragnano, a town south of Naples in the region of Campania. Gragnano is considered the birthplace of Italian dried pasta; according to legend, the breezes that flow from the mountains to the sea created the perfect conditions for drying pasta, and until the last century, all Gragnano families made and dried pasta in the streets. Today, the rich, nutty aroma of pasta still wafts through the streets, but only 12 producers have been given IGP (Indicazione Geografica Protetta) status for continuing to craft pasta according to Gragnano tradition.

description:
Committed to Organic
All of the grains that we use at Monograno Felicetti are exclusively from certified organic farming practices. Khorasan wheat, kamut, is an ancient grain and we rigorously select ours in collaboration with sustainable producers. Our kamut is organically grown, manufactured using bronze dies, and limited in production.

Rigatoni
Rigatoni is a classic, short pasta with ridges that hold sauces very well, perfect for pairing with seafood and pesto. An enduring icon, a monument to traditional recipes, Rigatoni pairs the fine nuances of Kamut Khorasan wheat with the powerful weaving of its ridges.

Delight Your Senses
When kamut pasta cooks, it releases a wonderful aroma of white flowers and freshly shelled nuts. The flavor combines unmistakable hints of pine and macadamia nuts with subtle nuances of edible flowers.

A Healthy Choice
This delicious heirloom wheat pasta is a good source of protein and fiber, making it a healthy part of your diet. Our organic rigatoni noodles are also Kosher certified, GMO-free, USDA organic, fat-free, and sugar-free.

Kamut Wheat
Kamut is Khorasan-type durum wheat that originated in the Middle East several thousand years ago and is the ancestor of our modern grains. Kamut is twice the size of modern-day wheat and is known for its rich nutty flavor.

Upgrade Your Meals
Cook for just 11 minutes and enjoy it as part of your favorite dish. Pair kamut noodles with seafood and pesto or your favorite meats and vegetables for a delightful meal.

Product of Italy
Since 1908 the same family, with the same values, has been working passionately in the beautiful landscape of the Dolomites. They take wheat from the field to the table with minimal processing in order to preserve the wheat’s distinct and natural qualities. Monograno Felicetti commits to using only 100% spring water, directly from the mountains in their region.

description: De Cecco gently grinds the heart of each grain, mixes it with cold spring water, then kneads the dough slowly. This results in pasta with the exceptional de Cecco aroma, flavor, and consistency. Pasta easily cooks to perfection, has a great firm texture, and a delicious “fresh” pasta taste. Since 1886 we have liked our pasta to be bronze drawn and slowly dried because we like it to fall into the plate full of taste, rough and always "al dente". Even though our taste has not changed, as we feel the same love for tradition, we have continued to improve our production technologies. Make de Cecco pasta the secret ingredient for your most amazing dishes.Buon Appetito! Penne Lisce are part of the short, diagonal cut, smooth pasta family and are one of the most well-known type of pasta, as well as being the most versatile for cooking. The lack of ridges is compensated for by a surprising softness which makes it exceptionally delicate on the palate. It is a delicate and sophisticated pasta which brings out the best in aromas, flavours and fragrance. In Italian, the term "Penne" refers to the goose feather which was used historically to write with and was cut on a diagonal to achieve a really thin tip. The shape, obtained from a pasta tube, can be smooth or ridged, of varying length and has the typical diagonal cut of a quill. Penne are one of the few types of pasta for which there is an exact date when it was created. Indeed, in 1865, a pasta-maker from San Martino d'Albaro (Genoa), Giovanni Battista Capurro, requested and obtained a patent for a diagonal cutting machine. The patent was important because it meant the fresh pasta could be cut like a quill without crushing it and in different lengths from 3 to 5 centimetres (mezze "half" penne or penne). description: Versatile PastaPennoni is Italian for “large quills” and their shape resembles the end of a quill pen. The pasta has a rustic texture that is porous and because of this, it is the perfect pasta to combine with every type of sauce. Our Pennoni pasta is a larger version of penne and has large tubes that can hold onto hearty meat sauces and can even be stuffed before baking. Pennoni is versatile and can be used in simple dishes with light seasoning as well as being paired with meats, cheeses, or vegetables.Imported From ItalyNo one knows pasta like the Italians, and the Panarese family is a superb example of this. Pasta Panarese creates authentic Italian pasta exclusively from wheat grown in Panarese's own fields in the beautiful Val d'Orcia (Orcia Valley) in the province of Siena. Val d'Orcia is a wonderful Tuscan valley that is a Natural Park, as well as a UNESCO World Heritage site. Since ancient times it has been renowned for its high-quality durum wheat.The nature of the soil and the relative summer dryness give durum wheat a high index of high-quality proteins and gluten. Panarese's gourmet Italian pasta is also made with water that flows from Monte Amiata (Mount Amiata), an exceptionally pure water source with almost no calcium residue. Ancient ProcessesThis combination of certified and exceptional Italian ingredients is then formed into a variety of pasta shapes that are all drawn through a traditional bronze die. Each batch of pasta is then air-dried at a low temperature for a minimum of 72 hours. This is an extremely time-consuming process, but it ensures that the dried pasta does not crystallize as all industrial-made pasta does. As the ancient process makes the surface of the pasta rustic and very rough, it will hold onto whatever you choose to pair it with. description:
De Cecco gently grinds the heart of each grain, mixes it with cold spring water, then kneads the dough slowly. This results in pasta with the exceptional de Cecco aroma, flavor, and consistency. Pasta easily cooks to perfection, has a great firm texture, and a delicious “fresh” pasta taste. It has a rougher surface, which helps the sauce stick to it. Since 1886 we have liked our pasta to be bronze drawn and slowly dried because we like it to fall into the plate full of taste, rough and always "al dente". Even though our taste has not changed, as we feel the same love for tradition, we have continued to improve our production technologies. Make de Cecco pasta the secret ingredient for your most amazing dishes.Buon Appetito! Orecchiette (little ears), also known as "strascicati", are a typical pasta shape from the Apulia culinary tradition. The shape is a round disc with a slight indent in the centre. In the culinary tradition of Apulia of home-made pasta, orecchiette were made with white flour, durum wheat semolina and water. After the pasta dough had been cut into small pieces, it was "dragged" ("strascicati" in Italian) with the tip of a knife to create a sort of small shell, then pulled back with the tip of the thumb. In traditional Apulia cooking, orecchiette are cooked in boiling water with broccoli or potatoes and served with a tomato sauce and sheep's cheese, or with garlic and Oil This pasta is also known as "Recchie" and is served with vegetable ragù, or lamb and ricotta ragù. Available in 1 e 5 lb.

De Cecco טוחן בעדינות את הלב של כל גרגר, מערבב אותו עם מי מעיין קרים, ואז לוש את הבצק לאט. התוצאה היא פסטה עם ניחוח דה Cecco יוצא דופן, טעם ועקביות. פסטה מתבשלת בקלות לשלמות, בעלת מרקם מוצק נהדר, וטעם פסטה "טרי" טעים. יש לו משטח מחוספס יותר, מה שעוזר לרוטב להידבק אליו. מאז 1886 אהבנו שהפסטה שלנו תימשך ויתייבש לאט כי אנחנו אוהבים שהיא תיפול לתוך צלחת מלאה בטעם, מחוספס ותמיד "אל דנטה". למרות שהטעם שלנו לא השתנה, שכן אנו מרגישים את אותה אהבה למסורת, המשכנו לשפר את טכנולוגיות הייצור שלנו. הכינו פסטה דה צ'קו את המרכיב הסודי למנות המדהימות ביותר שלכם. Buon Appetito! Orecchiette (אוזניים קטנות), הידועות גם בשם "strascicati", הן צורת פסטה טיפוסית מהמסורת הקולינרית של Apulia. הצורה היא דיסק עגול עם שקע קטן במרכז. במסורת הקולינרית של Apulia של פסטה תוצרת בית, orecchiette נעשו עם קמח לבן, סולת חיטה דורום ומים. לאחר שבצק הפסטה נחתך לחתיכות קטנות, הוא "נגרר" ("strascicati" באיטלקית) עם קצה סכין כדי ליצור מעין קליפה קטנה, ואז נמשך לאחור עם קצה האגודל. בבישול Apulia מסורתי, orecchiette מבושלים במים רותחים עם ברוקולי או תפוחי אדמה ומגישים עם רוטב עגבניות וגבינת כבשים, או עם שום ושמן פסטה זו ידועה גם בשם "Recchie" והיא מוגשת עם ראגו ירקות, או טלה וריקוטה. זמין ב-1 ו-2.3 ק"ג.

De Cecco mahlt sanft das Herz jedes Getreide, mischt es mit kaltem Quellwasser, dann knetet den Teig langsam. Dadurch ergibt sich Nudeln mit dem außergewöhnlichen Cecco-Aroma, Geschmack und Konsistenz. Pasta kocht leicht bis zur Perfektion, hat eine großartige feste Textur und einen köstlichen "frischen" Pasta-Geschmack. Es hat eine rauere Oberfläche, die hilft, dass die Sauce daran haftet. Seit 1886 haben wir gerne unsere Pasta aus Bronze gezogen und langsam getrocknet, weil wir sie gerne in den Teller fallen, voller Geschmack, rauer und immer "al dente". Obwohl sich unser Geschmack nicht verändert hat, haben wir die gleiche Liebe zur Tradition spüren, unsere Produktionstechnologien weiterhin verbessert. Machen Sie de Cecco Nudeln zur Geheimzutat für Ihre erstaunlichsten Gerichte. Buon Appetito! Orecchiette (kleine Ohren), auch als "Strascicati" bekannt, sind eine typische Pasta-Form aus der Apulien kulinarischen Tradition. Die Form ist eine runde Scheibe mit einer leichten Vertiefung in der Mitte. In der kulinarischen Tradition Apuliens aus hausgemachten Nudeln wurden Orecchiette mit weißem Mehl, Durumweizengrieß und Wasser hergestellt. Nachdem der Nudelteig in kleine Stücke geschnitten wurde, wurde er mit der Spitze eines Messers "geschleppt" ("strascicati" auf Italienisch) eine Art kleine Muschel kreiert, dann mit der Daumenspitze zurückgezogen. In traditioneller Apulien-Küche werden Orecchiette in kochendem Wasser mit Brokkoli oder Kartoffeln gekocht und mit einer Tomatensauce und Schafkäse oder mit Knoblauch und Öl serviert. Diese Pasta ist auch bekannt als "Recchie" und wird mit Gemüse-Ragù oder Lamm und Ricotta Ragù serviert. Erhältlich in 1 e 2,3 kg.

يقوم دي سيسكو بطحن قلب كل حبة بلطف، ويخلطها بماء الينابيع البارد، ثم يعجن العجين ببطء. يؤدي ذلك إلى المعكرونة برائحة دي سيسكو الاستثنائية والنكهة والقوام. تطبخ المعكرونة بسهولة بشكل مثالي، ولها ملمس قوي رائع، ومذاق المعكرونة "الطازج" اللذيذ. تتميز بسطح خشن يساعد على التصاق الصلصة بها. منذ عام 1886، أحببنا أن تكون المعكرونة الخاصة بنا مصورة بالبرونز وتجفيفها ببطء لأننا نحب أن تقع في طبق مليء بالطعم والخشنة ودائمًا "ALDT". على الرغم من أن ذوقنا لم يتغير، إلا أننا نشعر بنفس حب التقليد، فقد استمرنا في تحسين تقنيات الإنتاج لدينا. اجعل معكرونة دي سيسكو المكون السري لأطباقك الأكثر روعة. بون أبتيتو! الأوريكشييت (آذان صغيرة)، المعروف أيضًا باسم "ستراسيكاتي"، هو شكل معكرونة نموذجي من تقليد أبوليا للطهي. الشكل عبارة عن قرص دائري مع نسبة منخفضة في المنتصف. في التقاليد الطبخية لأبوليا المعكرونة المصنوعة منزليًا، تم تصنيع الأوريكييت من الدقيق الأبيض والسماد قمح الدوروم والماء. بعد أن يتم قطع عجينة المعكرونة إلى قطع صغيرة، كان "سحب" ("ستراسيكاتي" في إيطاليا) مع طرف السكين لإنشاء نوع من القشرة الصغيرة، ثم اسحبها إلى الخلف بطرف الإبهام. في طهي الأبوليا التقليدي، يتم طهي الأوريكتشييت في الماء المغلي بالبروكلي أو البطاطس ويتم تقديمها مع صلصة الطماطم وجبن الأغنام أو الثوم والزيت. هذه المعكرونة معروفة أيضًا باسم "ريتشي" ويتم تقديمها مع الخروف النباتي أو الخروف والريكوتا. متوفر بوزن 1 إلى 2.2 كجم.

De Cecco moe suavemente o coração de cada grão, mistura-o com água fria e depois amassa a massa lentamente. Isso resulta em macarrão com o aroma excepcional de Cecco, sabor e consistência. A massa cozinha facilmente com perfeição, tem uma ótima textura firme e um delicioso sabor de macarrão "fresco". Tem uma superfície mais áspera, o que ajuda o molho a grudar. Desde 1886, gostamos que nossas massas fossem desenhadas em bronze e secas lentamente porque gostamos que caiam no prato cheio de sabor, áspero e sempre "al dente". Embora nosso gosto não tenha mudado, pois sentimos o mesmo amor pela tradição, continuamos a melhorar nossas tecnologias de produção. Faça do macarrão Cecco o ingrediente secreto para seus pratos mais incríveis. Orecchiette (pequenas orelhas), também conhecida como "strascicati", são uma forma típica de macarrão da tradição culinária da Apúlia. A forma é um disco redondo com um pequeno recuo no centro. Na tradição culinária da Apúlia de massas caseiras, orecchiette foram feitas com farinha branca, sêmolina de trigo duro e água. Após a massa de macarrão ter sido cortada em pequenos pedaços, ela foi "arrastada" ("strascicati" em italiano) com a ponta de uma faca para criar uma espécie de concha pequena, depois puxada para trás com a ponta do polegar. Na culinária tradicional da Apúlia, o orecchiette é cozido em água fervente com brócolis ou batatas e servido com um molho de tomate e queijo de ovelha, ou com alho e óleo. Esta massa também é conhecida como "Recchie" e é servida com ragu vegetal, ou cordeiro e ricotta ragu. Disponível em 1 e 2,2 kg.

De Cecco 可轻柔地研磨每一粒谷物的心,混合冷水,然后慢慢揉搓面团。 因此，意大利面具有非凡的德塞克香气，味道和稠度。 轻松烹饪的意大利面,口感坚实,口感"新鲜",是一款美味意大利面。 表面粗糙,有助于酱汁粘住。 自 1886 年以来,我们一直喜欢青铜绘制并慢慢干燥,因为我们喜欢它落入充满味道、粗糙和总是"凹陷"的盘子中。 虽然味道没有改变,但我们对传统的同样热爱,我们不断改进生产技术。 让 de Cecco 意大利面成为您最美味的菜肴的秘密成分。Buon Appetito! 小耳朵也称为"strascicati",是普利亚烹饪传统的典型意大利面。 圆形盘,中间有轻微凹痕。 在自制意大利面的普利亚传统中,椭圆形由白面粉、硬小麦粗面粉和水制成。 将面团切成小块后,用刀尖"拖住"(意大利语中的"strascicati"),制作出一种小壳,然后用拇指尖拉回。 在传统的阿普利亚烹饪中,在煮沸水中用西兰花或土豆煮沸,配上番茄酱和绵羊奶酪,或大蒜和油。这种意大利面也被称为"Recchie",配合蔬菜面条或羊肉和意大利干酪。 1 e 5 磅

De Cecco 輕輕研磨每個穀物的心,與冷水混合,然後慢慢揉麵團。 這導致意大利麵具有卓越的 de Cecco 香氣、風味和一致性。 義大利麵可輕鬆烹飪成完美,質地堅固,美味「新鮮」義大利麵。 它具有更粗糙的表面,有助於醬汁粘在上面。 自 1886 年以來,我們一直喜歡我們的義大利麵以青銅製成,慢慢乾燥,因為我們喜歡它倒入充滿味道、粗糙且始終「al dente」。 雖然我們的品嘗沒有改變,但我們感受到對傳統的一樣愛,但我們持續改善我們的生產技術。 讓 de Cecco 意大利麵成為您最令人驚奇的菜餚的秘密成分。Buon Appetito! Orecchiette(小耳朵),也被稱為「strascicati」,是來自 Apulia 烹飪傳統的典型義大利麵形狀。 形狀為圓形圓盤,中央有輕微凹陷。 在 Apulia 自制義大利麵的烹飪傳統中,彎腸由白麵粉、硬粒小麥粉和水製成。 義大利麵麵團切成小塊後,用刀尖「拖曳」(義大利文中的「strascicati」),以製作一種小殼,然後用拇指的尖端拉回。 在傳統的 Apulia 烹飪中,通心菜在沸水中煮熟,用西蘭花或馬鈴薯,並搭配番茄醬和綿羊奶酪,或大蒜和油。這種通心粉也稱為「Recchie」,並搭配蔬菜拉古、羊肉和乳清乾酪。 提供 1 e 5 磅(約 2.3 公斤)尺寸。

De Cecco는 각 곡물의 심장을 부드럽게 갈고 찬 물을 섞은 다음 천천히 반죽을 반죽합니다. 이렇게 하면 탁월한 드 세코 향기, 맛 및 일관성이 있는 파스타가 만들어집니다. 파스타는 쉽게 요리할 수 있으며 단단한 질감과 맛있는 "신선한" 파스타 맛을 가지고 있습니다. 거친 표면을 가지고 있어 소스가 잘 붙습니다. 1886년부터 저희는 파스타를 청동색으로 뽑고 천천히 말리는 것을 좋아했습니다. 왜냐하면 우리는 그것이 맛있고 거칠고 항상 "알 덴트"로 가득한 접시에 빠지기를 좋아하기 때문입니다. 비록 전통에 대한 사랑을 느끼면서 취향은 변하지 않았지만, 생산 기술을 지속적으로 개선해왔습니다. 세코 파스타를 가장 놀라운 요리를 위한 비밀 성분으로 만들어보세요. 부온 식욕. "strascicati"라고도 알려진 오레키에트(작은 귀)는 Apulia 요리 전통의 전형적인 파스타 모양입니다. 모양은 중앙에 약간의 움푹 들어간 둥근 디스크입니다. 집에서 만든 파스타의 Apulia의 요리 전통에서 오레키에트는 흰 밀가루, 듀럼 밀 세몰리나 및 물로 만들어졌습니다. 파스타 반죽을 작은 조각으로 자르고 나면, 칼 끝으로 "끌고"(이탈리아어로 "strascicati")"와 함께 일종의 작은 껍질을 만든 다음 엄지손가락 끝으로 뒤로 당깁니다. 전통적인 Apulia 요리에서는 오레키에트를 브로콜리 또는 감자와 함께 끓는 물에서 요리하고 토마토 소스와 양 치즈, 마늘과 기름과 함께 제공합니다. 이 파스타는 "Recchie"라고도 알려져 있으며 채소 라구나 양과 리코타 라구와 함께 제공됩니다. 2.3kg (1 e 5 파운드)로 제공됩니다.

description: Faella Spaghettoni are spaghetti’s thicker cousins, so use them wherever you would spaghetti, for a slightly thicker mouthfeel. Pasta Faella is crafted according to tradition in the legendary birthplace of Italian dried pasta, Gragnano. This pasta is real Italian pasta at its best. When cooked, this pasta fills the room with the intense aroma of freshly baked bread and toasted grain. Its slightly rough, porous texture creates an ideal surface for collecting sauces, and its consistency is firm and chewy - just be sure to cook it al dente to fully savor its flavor and texture! Pasta Faella is made from nothing but the highest quality durum wheat and pristine spring waters from the Lattari mountains. The pasta is extruded through traditional bronze dies created specifically for each shape, and is air dried naturally for at least two days - unlike industrial pasta that is dried in less than an hour at high temperatures in electric ovens. According to Sergio Faella, in industrial pasta production, during high-temperature drying the pasta undergoes a kind of plastification, which causes it to absorb less water; in contrast, artisanal pasta expands visibly in water, is more easily digested, and gives a greater sense of satiety. Faella has been producing artisanal pasta since 1907, when Gaetano Faella founded the family company in Gragnano, a town south of Naples in the region of Campania. Gragnano is considered the birthplace of Italian dried pasta; according to legend, the breezes that flow from the mountains to the sea created the perfect conditions for drying pasta, and until the last century, all Gragnano families made and dried pasta in the streets. Today, the rich, nutty aroma of pasta still wafts through the streets, but only 12 producers have been given IGP (Indicazione Geografica Protetta) status for continuing to craft pasta according to Gragnano tradition.

description: About Mancini Pasta Our family produces top-quality pasta from wheat we grow in 10 hectares of our own fields in Le Marche, central Italy. We’ve worked this land for three generations in the unspoiled countryside of this beautiful hilly area. We harvest the grain in June and July, and rotate the fields with other crops like sunflowers and fava beans. To get nutritious, well-flavored pasta, you need to start with the best varieties of hard, durum wheat. That’s why we decided to grow our own and to make our pasta only from this freshly ground wheat. We built a custom-designed, small factory right in the middle of the wheat fields so we could control the quality of our wheat and every stage of the pasta production. We use bronze dies for the eleven pasta shapes we produce: they give an artisanal, textured finish to the pasta that makes it hold its sauces better. The pasta dries slowly at gentle temperatures so it retains all its wheat flavor and nutrients. Today, Massimo Mancini is guided by the teachings of his late grandfather, Mariano, as he works alongside his father, Giuseppe, to produce some of Italy's finest pasta.

description: Our Pasta is Something Else. The secret lies in the wheat germ! The products of the ancient Morelli pasta production factory are unique, the secret being an ingredient that is not found in most common types of pasta, which is wheat germ, the heart of the grain itself and which contains vitamins, as well as vegetable protein. During the normal cereal grinding process,the wheat germ is removed from the semolina in order to reduce the perishableness of the product, which means that the pasta factories are forced to process the flour without the wheat germ. But thanks to the craft workmanship methods used by the Morelli pasta factory the wheat germ , that is always fresh, is re-incorporated into the semolina; and this has given rise to our slogan “OUR PASTA IS SOMETHING ELSE”. Through years of using the wheat germ ingredient the ancient Morelli pasta factory has succeeded in obtaining a pasta with a unique and delicious taste, which releases a wonderful aroma on cooking, the cooking water, taking on a slight green hue, as the result of the presence of the fresh wheat germ ingredient. Pasta Morelli is considered to be of the finest quality, not only because of its wheat germ ingredient, but also because it selects the best durum wheat semolina, which is processed according to craft technique. The machines slowly press the kneaded mixture and, after having hand rolled it on frames, the pasta is dried in storage rooms for 36 hours at no more than 45°/50°C. Thereby maintaining the intrinsic taste and nutritious properties of the product. The ancient Morelli Pasta factory was founded in 1860, is a family-run enterprise, the fifth generation of the Morelli family, siblings Lucia, Antonio and Marco, continue to run the company today preserving its traditions. It produces a vast range of specialities, using ancient craft techniques, free of both preservatives and colouring agents. The result is truly wholesome pasta, with a wonderfully rich flavour and full consistency.

description: This is a recipe for making perfect Rice Vermicelli (Bun), a very thin rice noodle used in many Vietnamese dishes. The trick with these noodles is to boil minimally and allow to air-dry to get that springy texture. Rice noodles are the key ingredient in many Viet dishes. They are often the foundation for stir-fries and soups as well as fillers for assorted rice paper rolls. There seems to be endless types of rice noodles, all with different names. Like the Italians with their different pastas, many Viet dishes use a unique rice noodle such that using the wrong noodle would make that dish unrecognizable. Directions Bring a large pot filled with 7 cups water to a rapid boil. Add the noodles and boil for 2-3 minutes. Stirring gently with chopsticks to prevent sticking. Drain the rice vermicelli into the salad spinner colander. Rinse with cold water to stop the cooking process. Drain well. Spin the noodles in the salad spinner to remove the excess water. Spread the noodles on a large plate and allow to air dry for 15 minutes before serving. Refrigerate any remaining rice vermicelli. To reheat, warm in the microwave using Low power. Enjoy within a 1-2 days. Love Rice Vermicelli? Penne Rigate are part of the short, diagonal cut, ridged pasta family and are one of the most well-known type of pasta, as well as being the most versatile in the kitchen. In Italian, the term "Penne" refers to the goose feather which was used historically to write with and was cut on a diagonal to achieve a really thin tip. The shape, obtained from a pasta tube, can be smooth or ridged, of varying length and has the typical diagonal cut of a quill. Penne are one of the few types of pasta for which there is an exact date when it was created. Indeed, in 1865, a pasta-maker from San Martino d'Albaro (Genoa), Giovanni Battista Capurro, requested and obtained a patent for a diagonal cutting machine. The patent was important because it meant the fresh pasta could be cut like a quill without crushing it and in different lengths from 3 to 5 centimetres (mezze "half" penne or penne). The document preserved in the Central Archive of the State of Rome reads: "Up until now, a diagonal cut could only be made by hand with a pair of scissors which, in addition to being slow and time-consuming, also resulted in an irregular cut which flattened the pasta". Penne Rigate are perfect for preparing oven-baked pasta or pasta dishes served with meat sauces made from pork or beef. This pasta is equally as good with vegetable based sauces and more in general, due to its versatility, for any recipe from the Mediterranean tradition, such as the classic condiment with tomato, basil, extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of parmesan. A classic combination is with Arrabbiata sauce. Available in 16.0 oz and 5 lb.

Penne Lisce are part of the short, diagonal cut, smooth pasta family and are one of the most well-known type of pasta, as well as being the most versatile for cooking. The lack of ridges is compensated for by a surprising softness which makes it exceptionally delicate on the palate. It is a delicate and sophisticated pasta which brings out the best in aromas, flavours and fragrance. In Italian, the term "Penne" refers to the goose feather which was used historically to write with and was cut on a diagonal to achieve a really thin tip. The shape, obtained from a pasta tube, can be smooth or ridged, of varying length and has the typical diagonal cut of a quill. Penne are one of the few types of pasta for which there is an exact date when it was created. Indeed, in 1865, a pasta-maker from San Martino d'Albaro (Genoa), Giovanni Battista Capurro, requested and obtained a patent for a diagonal cutting machine. The patent was important because it meant the fresh pasta could be cut like a quill without crushing it and in different lengths from 3 to 5 centimetres (mezze "half" penne or penne). The document preserved in the Central Archive of the State of Rome reads: "Up until now, a diagonal cut could only be made by hand with a pair of scissors which, in addition to being slow and time-consuming, also resulted in an irregular cut which flattened the pasta". The ideal condiments for Penne Lisce are any kind of meat sauce: pork, beef, sausage, slow-cooked or braised, or meat and mushrooms. This pasta is equally as good with vegetable based sauces and more in general, due to its versatility, for any recipe from the Mediterranean tradition, such as the classic condiment with tomato, basil, extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of parmesan. A classic combination is with Arrabbiata sauce. Available in 16.0 oz and 5 lb.

description: De Cecco gently grinds the heart of each grain, mixes it with cold spring water, then kneads the dough slowly. This results in pasta with the exceptional de Cecco aroma, flavor, and consistency. Pasta easily cooks to perfection, has a great firm texture, and a delicious “fresh” pasta taste. It has a rougher surface, which helps the sauce stick to it. Since 1886 we have liked our pasta to be bronze drawn and slowly dried because we like it to fall into the plate full of taste, rough and always "al dente". Even though our taste has not changed, as we feel the same love for tradition, we have continued to improve our production technologies. Make de Cecco pasta the secret ingredient for your most amazing dishes.Buon Appetito! Lasagna is one of the oldest forms of pasta recorded. It probably corresponds to the Latin "Lagana" (which in turn was derived from the Greek "laganon": large, flat sheet of pasta cut into strips) and it began to be known as "Lasagna" probably after the year 1000 AD. The first traces of the widespread use of the term "Lasagna" can be found in the works of the most renowned 12th century Italian poets. "Granel di pepe vince / per virtù la lasagna", (a peppercorn beats lasagna for virtue) states Jacopone da Todi. Cecco Angiolieri,on the other hand, warns his readers, "chi de l'altrui farina fa lasagne / il su' castello non ha ne muro ne fosso" (He who makes lasagna with another's flour / his castle will have no walls or moat). It has long been one of the most well-known and popular types of pasta in Italian cooking, and the simplest and most commonly used recipe calls for a ragù, béchamel and parmesan, although mozzarella has also been introduced more recently. Delicious "white" versions are also quite commonplace with sauces made from mushrooms and vegetables. Available in 1 lb.

description:
Versatile Pasta
Pasta Panarese Fusilloni is a short, curly pasta, a larger version of fusilli, that can hold onto hearty sauces and works in place of penne in casseroles and other baked pasta dishes. The pasta has a rustic texture that is porous and because of this, it is the perfect pasta to combine with every type of sauce. Fusilloni is versatile and can be used in simple dishes with light seasoning as well as being paired with meats, cheeses, or vegetables.

Imported From Italy
No one knows pasta like the Italians, and the Panarese family is a superb example of this. Pasta Panarese creates authentic Italian pasta exclusively from wheat grown in Panarese's own fields in the beautiful Val d'Orcia (Orcia Valley) in the province of Siena. Val d'Orcia is a wonderful Tuscan valley that is a Natural Park, as well as a UNESCO World Heritage site. Since ancient times it has been renowned for its high-quality durum wheat.

The nature of the soil and the relative summer dryness give durum wheat a high index of high-quality proteins and gluten. Panarese's pasta is also made with water that flows from Monte Amiata (Mount Amiata), an exceptionally pure water source with almost no calcium residue.

Ancient Processes
This combination of certified and exceptional Italian ingredients is then formed into a variety of pasta shapes that are all drawn through a traditional bronze die. Each batch of pasta is then air-dried at a low temperature for a minimum of 72 hours. This is an extremely time-consuming process, but it ensures that the dried pasta does not crystallize as all industrial-made pasta does. As the ancient process makes the surface of the pasta rustic and very rough, it will hold onto whatever you choose to pair it with. description:
Versatile Pasta
Pasta Panarese Tagliarini is long, slender, and flat egg noodles, narrower than tagliatelle and can hold onto hearty sauces and works in place of penne in casseroles and other baked pasta dishes. The pasta has a rustic texture that is porous and because of this, it is the perfect pasta to combine with every type of sauce. Tagliarini pasta is versatile and can be used in simple dishes with light seasoning as well as being paired with meats, cheeses, or vegetables.

Imported From Italy
No one knows pasta like the Italians, and the Panarese family is a superb example of this. Pasta Panarese creates authentic Italian pasta exclusively from wheat grown in Panarese's own fields in the beautiful Val d'Orcia (Orcia Valley) in the province of Siena. Val d'Orcia is a wonderful Tuscan valley that is a Natural Park, as well as a UNESCO World Heritage site. Since ancient times it has been renowned for its high-quality durum wheat.

The nature of the soil and the relative summer dryness give durum wheat a high index of high-quality proteins and gluten. Panarese's pasta is also made with water that flows from Monte Amiata (Mount Amiata), an exceptionally pure water source with almost no calcium residue.

Ancient Processes
This combination of certified and exceptional Italian ingredients is then formed into a variety of pasta shapes that are all drawn through a traditional bronze die. Each batch of pasta is then air-dried at a low temperature for a minimum of 72 hours. This is an extremely time-consuming process, but it ensures that the dried pasta does not crystallize as all industrial-made pasta does. As the ancient process makes the surface of the pasta rustic and very rough, it will hold onto whatever you choose to pair it with. The process also helps to preserve the taste, smell, and look of the pasta for a unique sensory experience with your next meal.

description: Our Pasta is Something Else. The secret lies in the wheat germ! The products of the ancient Morelli pasta production factory are unique, the secret being an ingredient that is not found in most common types of pasta, which is wheat germ, the heart of the grain itself and which contains vitamins, as well as vegetable protein. During the normal cereal grinding process,the wheat germ is removed from the semolina in order to reduce the perishableness of the product, which means that the pasta factories are forced to process the flour without the wheat germ. But thanks to the craft workmanship methods used by the Morelli pasta factory the wheat germ , that is always fresh, is re-incorporated into the semolina; and this has given rise to our slogan “OUR PASTA IS SOMETHING ELSE”. Through years of using the wheat germ ingredient the ancient Morelli pasta factory has succeeded in obtaining a pasta with a unique and delicious taste, which releases a wonderful aroma on cooking, the cooking water, taking on a slight green hue, as the result of the presence of the fresh wheat germ ingredient. Pasta Morelli is considered to be of the finest quality, not only because of its wheat germ ingredient, but also because it selects the best durum wheat semolina, which is processed according to craft technique. The machines slowly press the kneaded mixture and, after having hand rolled it on frames, the pasta is dried in storage rooms for 36 hours at no more than 45°/50°C. Thereby maintaining the intrinsic taste and nutritious properties of the product. The ancient Morelli Pasta factory was founded in 1860, is a family-run enterprise, the fifth generation of the Morelli family, siblings Lucia, Antonio and Marco, continue to run the company today preserving its traditions. It produces a vast range of specialities, using ancient craft techniques, free of both preservatives and colouring agents. The result is truly wholesome pasta, with a wonderfully rich flavour and full consistency.
